answer: The tundra is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the tide. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the velvet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
